faq.title: We've Got Answers
faq.description: Everything you need to know before getting started

q1.question: What baggage damage is covered?
q1.answer: All physical damage to checked baggage during your Eurowings flight — broken wheels, torn fabric, cracked shells, damaged handles, dents, and scratches. Normal wear and tear is not covered.

q2.question: What do I need to get started?
q2.answer: Just your booking reference or flight number, a couple of photos of the damage, and a brief description. We'll guide you through everything — it takes about 5 minutes.

q3.question: How fast will I get a decision?
q3.answer: Most claims are resolved within 24 hours. You'll get updates at every step, and if we need anything extra, we'll reach out right away — no waiting in limbo.

q4.question: How is compensation paid out?
q4.answer: Via bank transfer or as a Eurowings flight voucher, depending on the damage type and your preference. We'll walk you through the options.

q5.question: Can I check my claim status anytime?
q5.answer: Absolutely. Return to the chat anytime to check progress. You'll also receive email updates at every key milestone.

q6.question: What if additional information is needed?
q6.answer: You'll get a notification with a link back to the chat. Just pick up where you left off — we remember the entire conversation.
